title: Ghost
about: The nickname I earned for quietly appearing and disappearing around the State Arts-In fairgrounds.
description: This track reflects on the nickname "Ghost," given to me because I quietly moved from place to place without anyone noticing. What began as a joke became a sign that I truly belonged. For someone who rarely sought attention, being noticed enough to receive a nickname meant I had become part of the community.

Lyrics: I was never good at entering
I'd stand there near the outside
Till the words came drifting round.
Then I'd listen for a while,
Say a little if I could,
And before they thought to notice,
I'd be somewhere else for good.
Because I came and went unseen.
I was always somewhere near them,
I just never seemed to stay.
And somehow that meant I was part.
One second by the green room,
Someone turned to ask a question,
Found an empty patch of floor,
Because I came and went unseen.
I was always somewhere near them,
I just never seemed to stay.
And somehow that meant I was part.
I moved from group to group,
Never trying to take the lead.
But I learned a room by listening,
Learned the people by their tone,
And every time they called me Ghost,
The fair felt more like home.
Even if the name they gave me
It proved that I was present.
It proved they knew my worth.
Because I came and went unseen.
I was always somewhere near them,
I just never seemed to stay.
And somehow that meant I was part.
It can tell you that somebody
Has been watching all this time.
For someone used to standing back,
It mattered they knew my name.
Even if the name they gave me
It proved that I was present.
It proved they knew my worth.
Because I came and went unseen.
I was always somewhere near them,
I just never seemed to stay.
And somehow that meant I was part.
But I still hear somebody asking,
Then a laugh from just behind them,
They pulled me in by heart.
And the name still follows me
Through the hidden halls of memory
And everything I used to be.
And being glad you're back again.
